calls.query: query(root, db, file_id, sql, parameters=(), row_limit=1000, max_output_bytes=8388608, timeout_seconds=5)

input_scope: Current case retained file ID. Main and physically or logically associated companions require intake hash/size match. No arbitrary filesystem database access. All source and output ancestor symlinks refused.
execution: Separate isolated Python child opens only disposable working copies. Supplied SHM hashed and retained untouched; working SHM rebuilt. SQLite readonly URI, query_only, trusted_schema off, SELECT/READ/function allowlist authorizer, SQLite limits, progress deadline and child timeout. This is not a general OS sandbox.
result: Ordered columns plus JSONL row arrays; duplicate column names, Unicode, int, float and NULL preserved. BLOB encoded as sqlite_blob_hex; nonfinite float explicitly tagged. Raw result only: no automatic artifact/finding/meaning promotion.
state_rules: Empty means this query returned zero rows, never no evidence.

Any supplied WAL remains pairing-unverified. Missing expected WAL produces limited checkpoint-only warning. Structurally valid foreign WAL can produce readable rows; no cryptographic association claim.
Caps set truncated and limit_reason. Failed partial rows retained as diagnostics but not exposed by result pager.
Validation/integrity preconditions raise UserError; admitted query failures have retained run/request/receipt/audit.
receipts: query.json, result.jsonl if produced, worker-result.json, worker.stderr, receipt.json in runs/run_id. Start and finish hash-bound audit entries; pagination validates chain and query/receipt/result hashes plus exact run detail. Local hash chain is tamper detection, not authenticated external attestation.
ui_contract: Present exact SQL and bound parameters, source logical path/hash and supplied companion hashes.
Show state/warnings/truncation and row cap beside every result.
Render arrays against ordered columns, never zip into dictionaries that collapse duplicate names.
Show BLOB hex as bytes, not inferred text.
Do not equate successful query with examiner verification or recovered deleted messages.
Query values/results may contain sensitive evidence. No redaction support or safe external share claim.
not_done: independent examiner validation on acquired schema queries
bridge_validation: Actual stdio query/schema/paged-result, denied write, case isolation, invalid limits; combined30focused tests pass with candidate source PYTHONPATH.
